what: Runtimes, orchestrators, cloud services and interchange standards Substrate can talk to: it decodes a map into a runtime's native format and encodes the runtime's state and history back (S-174). A licence decides only whether one can be a default part (rule 7); any of them can be a target for a business that already runs it.
